gaps.what: 1788 step (+3,000 km2) and the cell-level changes of 1670-1744 are not dated by any page opened; the owners of Cape Coast and Anomabu 1637-1652 are unnamed; the Ankobra posts (Ruychaver 1654-59, Elize Carthago) are not in the ledger; no infobox area exists
Fort extents are cell-sized points; the 1861 Nigerian block is judged an error without a page naming its origin

Loss of the Ivory Coast part in 1895, the 1769 shrinkage, the east of the 1757-1768 shape (Togo cells removed on a weak undated sentence), and the post-1874 breakup (Dwaben, Wassa, Gyaman) have no dated page
Akwamu, Akuapim and Sehwi submitted at the end of Osei Kwadwo's reign (undated) and the Dutch tribute for Elmina: no event written

Steps of 1670, 1734, 1752 and 1769 have no dating page (conf 1 events); the Ewe, Aja, Egba, Egbado and Porto-Novo tributaries are inside the shape as direct land; the 1769 shape overlaps the Ashanti 1769 shape between 0.1 and 0.7 E; the move to Ago d'Oyo and the founding of Ibadan and Abeokuta are undated or thin
The 1744 contraction, Fort Witsen's recipient in 1658, 'Cong Heights' (1659-61), and the Christiansborg sequence 1660-63 (Osu page vs Swedish page) are unsettled
No page opened gives the colony's extent, the date of the 1788 purchase, or an event for 1796; Sierra Leone Company and Colony of Sierra Leone pages were not opened

problems: The WebFetch extractor paraphrases pages: quoted phrases in ledger notes are its rendering of the dated sentence, not byte-exact copies.

Cliopatria rows that are wrong or overlong: Dutch Gold Coast 1853-1872 (Danish cells, a 22-cell Nigerian block, forts east of Elmina after 1868); Danish Gold Coast to 1852 (sold 1850) and Cape Coast cells to 1733 (sold 1685); Ashanti to 1897 (state ends 1896) and full Pra-to-sea outline after 1831; Oyo without Oyo-Ile in 1820-1835 and with Dahomey inside 1752-1835.

Start years differ from Cliopatria's first shape in every dossier: dutch-gold-coast 1612 (row 1653), ashanti-empire 1701 (1702), oyo-empire 1300 (1609, estimate, low confidence), danish-gold-coast 1658 (1659), freetown-colony 1787 (1788); freetown-colony also ends 1808, not 1796, and ashanti-empire 1896, not 1897; the colour/shape agents must read identity.start/end.
The Christiansborg Castle Wikipedia page is the Copenhagen palace, not the Accra castle; the Accra castle page is 'Osu Castle' (used).

Page budget: dutch-gold-coast opened 10 pages against up to 9 (the Danish, Fante and British-colony pages are shared or context); ashanti-empire 6 (the British-colony page was read for the Dutch dossier first); the others are within budget.

Gazetteer: 21 place names are missing (listed); the Dutch dossier has 46 resolve warnings, Oyo 8, Danish 8, Ashanti 1 (a slug), Freetown 0. Fort radii are 12 km or more because an 8 km radius around a coastal fort can resolve to zero cells.

No British polygon exists for the Gold Coast before 1873 (Cape Coast, Dixcove, Apollonia, Komenda, Sekondi and the Danish forts from 1850): an af-08 task. Dutch Gold Coast uses family 'france' to match dutch-brazil and dutch-suriname.
The Oyo capital Igboho and several fort coordinates are approximate positions from general geographic knowledge, not from the pages; they are structural (capitals, place hints), not dated events.
